name: Glen Well shaft
notes: The Glen Well in the scene briar-glen-green (mw-e24.10). At the foot of the shaft, one rung of the ladder is loose: pulling it (a lever bound to glen-well-rung) raises the old grate (a portcullis, glen-well-grate) into the cistern tunnel for good, and the latch writes world.glen-well.rung-pulled = true, the unlock of the world map's glen-well-cistern shortcut. Pulling the rung back does nothing: the latch keeps the grate up.
